jobs.description:
Join Michael Page as a Recruitment Consultant and play a key role in identifying, attracting, and placing the best talent in the market.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Michael Page is a global leader in specialized recruitment, renowned for its expertise, high-performance culture, and exceptional career development opportunities.

Omschrijving

• Identify and engage top-tier talent within your market.
• Build and manage strong relationships with clients.
• Conduct interviews and assess candidates' skills and potential.
• Advise clients and candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Negotiate offers and successfully close placements.

• Speaks French, Dutch and English perfectly
• Ambitious, driven, and results-oriented individuals.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for challenges.
• Resilient, proactive, and highly motivated.
• Eager to grow and succeed in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL
 Join BNP Paribas Fortis' AI Tribe, a team of 90+ AI experts driving innovation across the bank through advanced analytics and Artificial Intelligence.

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you will design and deploy cutting-edge AI solutions to combat evolving financial crime threats. Combining machine learning, graph analytics, and Generative AI, you will transform data into actionable intelligence that helps protect our customers, strengthen the bank's resilience, and shape the future of fraud prevention.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you'll design, build, and deploy AI solutions to help protect our bank and customers from evolving fraud threats. You'll work within our AI Tribe and collaborate with Fraud Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams to transform data into actionable fraud prevention and detection capabilities.

What You'll Do

• Develop and enhance fraud detection models using machine learning, anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, and graph analytics.
• Analyze large-scale transactional and behavioral data to uncover suspicious patterns and emerging fraud schemes.
• Engineer features, enrich datasets, and apply a data-centric and error-analysis approach to continuously improve model performance.
• Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into scalable AI solutions.
• Investigate complex fraud cases, identify emerging attack vectors, and proactively mitigate risks.
• Leverage advanced AI techniques (traditional machine learning and also LLMs and Generative AI), to support fraud investigations and strengthen fraud prevention capabilities.
• Stay ahead of AI and fraud trends to continuously enhance our detection and prevention strategies.
 

 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Education & Experience

• Master’s in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or related field (PhD a plus).
• 3+ years in Data Science, preferably in financial services/fraud detection.
• Experience with fraud analytics, AML, or financial crime prevention.
 

Technical Skills

• Data-Centric AI & Data Engineering: Data collection, labeling, curation, enrichment, feature engineering, data quality, feedback, and large-scale data processing. 
• AI & Fraud Analytics:
• Machine Learning: Supervised and unsupervised learning for anomaly and fraud detection, model evaluation, performance monitoring, and error analysis.
• Advanced Analytics: Graph analytics, network analytics, behavioral analytics, and financial crime analytics.
• Generative AI & Foundation Models: LLMs, RAG, AI agents, deep learning , transactional model and AI-driven fraud prevention solutions.
• Programming & AI Engineering: Advanced Python, software engineering best practices, AI application development and deployment, monitoring, and end-to-end AI lifecycle management. 
 

Soft Skills

• Analytical, proactive, and results-driven.
• Strong communicator who thrives in multidisciplinary teams.
• Comfortable in an international, fast-paced environment.
 

Languages

• Fluent English + Dutch or French (professional level).

Responsibilities

• Analyze business needs and translate them into functional specifications and use cases for data pipelines and reporting.
• Provide recommendations on reporting techniques using mockups, proof-of-concepts, and industry best practices.
• Develop and manage roadmaps by collaborating with data users and suppliers across various departments.
• Assist development and testing teams in translating functional requirements into validated data assets.
• Document solutions and maintain up-to-date technical documentation to ensure architectural alignment.
• Coordinate with data owners and architects to ensure all solutions comply with the existing business and system architecture.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in a similar position such as Functional Analyst or Application Owner.
• Proven experience with the Azure data estate.
• In-depth knowledge of analysis techniques including use cases and scenario creation.
• Experience working within Agile Scrum environments.
• You possess a Master’s degree.
• You have knowledge of transport operations within the railway or public infrastructure sector.
• You possess strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• You are methodical, precise, and proactive with strong problem-solving abilities.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French at a C-level with B2 level proficiency in the other language and English.
Nice to Haves

• Willingness to explore new reporting methodologies and visualization tools.

Working at Michael Page means joining an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and performance-driven environment where consultants are empowered to develop their own client portfolio, advise businesses on talent strategies, and make a real impact on people's careers. The company promotes a culture of teamwork, integrity, meritocracy, and continuous career development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and candidates.
• Identify and source top talent through various recruitment methods.
• Manage the full recruitment cycle, from job briefing to offer negotiation.
• Provide expert advice to clients on market trends and hiring strategies.
• Screen, interview, and assess candidates for suitability.
• Ensure a high standard of service delivery to both clients and candidates.

A successful Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• An ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English and French OR Dutch.
• Passion for sales, recruitment, and business development
• A proactive mindset.

jobs.occupation: Become a Butcher in Wholesale – Quality Meat Processing in Aartselaar
jobs.description:
As a butcher in our wholesale department, you are responsible for expertly processing quality meat for professional customers in Belgium and abroad. You work precisely and efficiently in a modern production environment where craftsmanship is key. Your duties include deboning, cutting, and portioning beef, pork, lamb, and poultry to the specified weights and customer requirements. You also prepare ground meats and charcuterie, conduct quality checks, and ensure products are packaged and labeled correctly.

A typical workday starts early in the morning. You begin at 6:00 am with your close-knit team. Your responsibilities include deboning, cutting, and weighing meat, always paying attention to detail and quality. You follow strict procedures to guarantee food safety and contribute to a smooth production flow. During lunch, you and your colleagues enjoy our house-made meat products, and you finish your workday by 2:00 pm.

Are you a skilled professional who likes to roll up your sleeves and is committed to quality? Apply today and join our team of passionate butchers!

• Thorough knowledge of the complete breakdown and deboning of a beef carcass (very important)

• Skilled at cutting to weight and deboning meat

• Precise and efficient work ethic with a keen eye for detail and quality

• Motivated, reliable, and takes initiative

• Able to work independently and as part of a team

• Good command of English and willing to learn Dutch

• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays if needed

• Completed lower or higher secondary education

• At least 2 years of experience as a butcher (5–10 years or more is a plus)

• 
You will ensure correct processing and shipping of incoming goods.

 
• 
Here you follow a pick order to pack and sort the goods according to destination.

 
• 
You can remain calm in stressful situations

 
• 
You can maintain a good overview of your work

 
• 
You can communicate perfectly in English.

 
• 
You will work from 08:00 to 16:15.

jobs.occupation: Account Manager Medical Devices - East Flanders & Antwerp
jobs.description:
Our client is a global leader in implants and orthodontic solutions who is at the forefront of digital transformation in dentistry, offering complete workflows that integrate software and hardware solutions-from patient entry into the dental practice to final prosthetic delivery.
The company emphasizes a personal approach, coaching, and growth opportunities, with decisions made locally to adapt to market needs.

As a successful Account Manager Medical Devices - East Flanders & Antwerp, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Manage and grow existing accounts (approx. 65% farming) and acquire new customers (approx. 35% hunting) by building, developing and maintaining strong & long-term relationships with dental professionals and stakeholders
• Drive sales of dental implants, prosthetic, and digital solutions in East Flanders & Antwerp, focusing on hospitals, dental practices, and dental labs.
• Understand customer needs and provide complete solutions, from patient acceptance and diagnostic data capture to surgery and final prosthetic delivery.
• Educate dental professionals on the benefits, the utilization and the clinical aspects of products and digital workflows.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure high-quality services and products delivery 
• Organize workshops, lunch-and-learn sessions, and participate in trade show

As a successful Account Manager Medical Devices - East Flanders & Antwerp, you will have the following profile:

• +3 years of experience as Account Manager in the Pharma or Medtech industry
• Previous experience in both direct and indirect sales, with strong ability in farming and hunting
• Previous experiences or strong interest in dental products
• Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
• You are structured and proactive, you achieved KPI & are accurate with CRM update
• Your are autonomous, disciplined, and results-oriented, with a collaborative team spirit.
• Dutch Native & Fluent in English .

Ready to take the next step in your career? Apply now and join a team where your contributions will make a real impact. Click the apply button and start your journey with us today!

• Education in mechanics or equivalent experience

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.

You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.

Your responsibilities:
 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.
Working hours are from Monday to Friday in a two-shift system:
 
• Morning shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM 
• Afternoon shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You perform well in a team and communicate effectively with colleagues.

• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

 Are you an experienced manufacturing professional with a background in cell therapy and GMP? Would you like to play a key role in producing advanced therapies that have a direct impact on patients' lives? Then this position as Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician could be the perfect next step in your career.
 
 Job Description
 You will become part of an international pharmaceutical organization, focused on advanced cell and gene therapies. Working in a state-of-the-art GMP cleanroom, you will contribute to the manufacturing of innovative medicines while receiving comprehensive onboarding and continuous training. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your technical expertise within a fast-growing and highly regulated industry.
 As a Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician, your responsibilities include:

• Executing manufacturing activities in a GMP-compliant cleanroom using aseptic techniques
• Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting
• Accurately completing batch records and manufacturing documentation

 Employment Conditions
